messages:
sam_marketing: Quick sync thread final lock for tomorrow's announce. Need: consumer-friendly changelog (2 lines), prod docs permalink, a short benchmark vignette for social, webinar RSVP copy, and HubSpot routing + webhook.
elaine_pm: scope locked to batching perf and streaming stability. i'll post two concise bullets in a sec.
tyler_eng: canary slot is 16:00 UTC (10m canary + 25m observability hold). marketing please hold public posts until 16:40 UTC. we'll post status updates here.
sophia_docs: staging docs bundle live: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/rel-2-1-preview. adding a migration note, API diff and a tiny curl demo for the confirmation email. will publish prod permalink after deploy.
sam_marketing: draft changelog bullets (marketing-friendly):
- ~15% typical per-token cost reduction for embedding-heavy flows
- streaming reliability improvements  fewer reconnects in long conversations
one-line impact for email: "Lower token costs and steadier streaming make scaling inference easier."
tyler_eng: confirm the ~15% number is for our common embedding profile; please add qualifier "typical workloads" and avoid hardware specifics.
kevin_ops: i'll prepare the HubSpot webhook and enable it post-success. provisional endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-1712. i'll post a sample payload when it's live.
sam_marketing: webinar confirmation needs: docs permalink, slides link, demo notebook link, and the 1-line changelog. benchmark vignette should be anonymized (customer-style: "from 20k to 75k embeddings/day with ~15% lower unit cost").
deploy-bot: Canary started at 16:00 UTC. Posting events to #release-war-room.
tyler_eng: monitoring rule: if p99 > baseline * 1.20 or error rate spikes >3x, we'll pause the rollout and notify this thread.
deploy-bot: Canary success at 16:08 UTC. Observability hold until 16:33 UTC. Event payload sample: { "event":"release", "version":"2.1", "status":"canary-success" }
kevin_ops: webhook enabled and smoke-tested. sample payload posted to #release-war-room. HubSpot workflow tag: launch-1712. routing mapping: enterprise -> SDR-1, trials -> nurture-flow.
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide  includes migration snippet, API diff, and quickstart. drive bundle (slides + notebook + benchmark gist): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-bundle
sam_marketing: scheduling social + email for 16:40 UTC (10m after hold). i'll drop social + email drafts here for a rapid PR in 10. Holding in-thread for any rollback signals. :rocket:
